summary.en: The same squares stand in one column per period, the protagonist at the base of each column lighting up together; or the standing columns step back and their tops become a curve: the same counts read as a trend.
summary.zh: 同一批方块按时期立成一列一列，主角压在每列底部、同一拍一起亮起；或者立好的列退成灰色，列顶连成一条曲线：同样的数读成趋势。

fits: A few real periods (≤ 24) over a counted set: when, and whether it is rising again.
notFor: Many time steps (a line chart reads better); periods that are not real (made-up bins).

intent.en: Time becomes columns of the same items, and the protagonist at the base of every column lights together, so 'when' and 'is it rising again' read in one picture.
intent.zh: 时间变成同一批方块堆成的柱，每根柱底部的主角一起亮起，“什么时候”和“是否又在上升”一眼读出。

content.en: Periods (2–24, label ≤ 8 / 4 字) with counts per group; a title (≤ 44 / 16 字); `reread: 'trend'` for the curve; `stagger: 'together'` lands every column at once.
content.zh: 时期（2–24 个，标签 ≤ 8 字符 / 4 字），每期各组数量；标题（≤ 44 / 16 字）；`reread: 'trend'` 读成曲线；`stagger: 'together'` 让所有柱一起落。

fits.zh: 计数集合上的几个真实时期（≤ 24）：什么时候，是否又在上升。

notFor.zh: 很多时间步（折线图更好读）；不真实的时期（编出来的分箱）。

en: Period by period the flight lands only after 1 + 0.25·(n − 1) + 2 beats; in a scene shorter than that set `stagger: 'together'` or the accent never shows.
zh: 逐期起飞要 1 + 0.25·(n − 1) + 2 拍才落完；场景比这短时设 `stagger: 'together'`，否则主角色来不及亮。
